subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers capture real Control UI browser/gateway proof for this watchdog branch, explicitly override the proof gate, or pause/close the replacement and keep the canonical issue open?
rationale: The useful fix direction is clear from source, but proof capture or proof override and the current-main port/refresh are maintainer-owned decisions rather than a narrow line-level repair verdict.

options.title: Prove and refresh the watchdog path
options.body: Capture redacted Control UI browser/gateway proof for missed-terminal recovery and queued-message flush, then port or rebase the branch to current chat modules before merge.

options.title: Override proof explicitly
options.body: A maintainer can accept the timer-driven recovery risk without browser/gateway proof, but should record that choice before merge.

options.title: Pause or close this replacement
options.body: If this watchdog design is not worth proof and refresh work, close or pause the PR while leaving the canonical issue available for a different current-main fix.

recommendation.title: Prove and refresh the watchdog path
recommendation.body: Capture redacted Control UI browser/gateway proof for missed-terminal recovery and queued-message flush, then port or rebase the branch to current chat modules before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current chat module split and resulting target files make this the best available owner for the current-main refresh decision.
